raw_text: The Ministry of External Affairs has taken note of the EU DisinfoLab report on the so-called 'Indian Chronicles' network. India categorically rejects the characterisation of legitimate Indian diaspora media outlets as part of any coordinated influence operation. Several of the outlets identified in the report are long-standing diaspora publications serving Indian communities abroad. India has a vibrant and free press ecosystem and does not need to resort to covert information operations. We urge the EU DisinfoLab to apply the same rigorous standards to influence operations originating from other countries in the region. India remains committed to combating disinformation through transparent democratic processes.
